normalization_pipeline.name: unicode_normalization
normalization_pipeline.rule: NFKD normalize and remove combining marks so Slovak/German diacritics do not block matches.

normalization_pipeline.name: casefold
normalization_pipeline.rule: Lowercase all query and index text.

normalization_pipeline.name: punctuation_standardization
normalization_pipeline.rule: Normalize hyphens, apostrophes and slashes. Convert gastro-omental and gastro omental to a comparable token form.

normalization_pipeline.name: roman_numeral_protection
normalization_pipeline.rule: Preserve cranial nerve numerals I-XII as protected tokens. Do not fuzzy-match protected tokens.

normalization_pipeline.name: abbreviation_expansion
normalization_pipeline.rule: Expand aliases like LAD, RCA, SMA, ICA, IJV, CN III, SOF, VAN, NAVL, PCHA, MCFA and CBD.

normalization_pipeline.name: synonym_expansion
normalization_pipeline.rule: Expand canonical anatomy terms using global_synonyms and per-correlation direct_synonyms.

normalization_pipeline.name: tokenize
normalization_pipeline.rule: Split into alphanumeric tokens, preserving protected tokens and anatomical compounds.

normalization_pipeline.name: stopword_removal
normalization_pipeline.rule: Remove general question words but keep side, relation and anatomical qualifiers.

normalization_pipeline.name: fuzzy_candidates
normalization_pipeline.rule: Apply bounded Damerau-Levenshtein only to unprotected anatomy tokens.

normalization_pipeline.name: safety_filter
normalization_pipeline.rule: Reject fuzzy matches that cross artery/vein, greater/lesser, left/right, or cranial nerve numeral boundaries.

result_policy.if_ambiguous: Show ranked suggestions and ask the user to choose; do not force a direct answer.

safety_examples.safe_behavior: Prefer gastro-omental arteries; penalize lesser-curvature gastric arteries.
Prefer right and left gastric arteries; penalize gastro-omental result.
Do not fuzzy-match to CN VI even though both are ocular motor nerves.
Do not return femoral artery as direct answer unless the femoral triangle order record is the match.
Detect trap: gastric arteries are lesser curvature; show correction.
